comment: Size of the PayPal Credit (Bill Me Later) banner shown on catalog category pages.
modal: Chooses the display size of the PayPal Credit / Bill Me Later promotional banner on the **Catalog Category Page**, from the available banner sizes. Applies only for the configured category-page banner position, and can be set per website.

comment: Size of the PayPal Credit (Bill Me Later) banner shown on the home page.
modal: Chooses the display size of the PayPal Credit / Bill Me Later promotional banner on the **Home Page**, from the available banner sizes. Applies only for the configured home-page banner position, and can be set per website.

comment: Whether the PayPal Pay Later message is shown on the shopping cart page.
modal: When **Yes**, the PayPal Pay Later promotional message appears on the **Checkout Cart Page**; when **No**, it is hidden. Can be set per website.

comment: Text color of the PayPal Pay Later message on the cart page.
modal: Selects the text color of the PayPal Pay Later message on the **Checkout Cart Page**, from the available color options. Applies only when the cart-page Pay Later message is enabled and its style layout is set to Text. Can be set per website.

comment: Placement of the PayPal Pay Later message on catalog category pages.
modal: Chooses where the PayPal Pay Later message is placed on the **Catalog Category Page**, from the available positions. Applies only when the category-page Pay Later message is enabled. Can be set per website.

comment: Whether the PayPal Pay Later message is shown at the checkout payment step.
modal: When **Yes**, the PayPal Pay Later promotional message appears at the **Checkout Payment Step**; when **No**, it is hidden. Can be set per website.

comment: Text color of the PayPal Pay Later message at the checkout payment step.
modal: Selects the text color of the PayPal Pay Later message at the **Checkout Payment Step**, from the available color options. Applies only when that message is enabled and its style layout is set to Text. Can be set per website.

comment: Placement of the PayPal Pay Later message on the home page.
modal: Chooses where the PayPal Pay Later message is placed on the **Home Page**, from the available positions. Applies only when the home-page Pay Later message is enabled. Can be set per website.

comment: Whether the PayPal Pay Later message is shown on product detail pages.
modal: When **Yes**, the PayPal Pay Later promotional message appears on the **Catalog Product Page**; when **No**, it is hidden. Can be set per website.

comment: Text color of the PayPal Pay Later message on product detail pages.
modal: Selects the text color of the PayPal Pay Later message on the **Catalog Product Page**, from the available color options. Applies only when the product-page message is enabled and its style layout is set to Text. Can be set per website.

comment: API certificate file used to authenticate the store's PayPal account for Express Checkout.
modal: Uploads the PayPal API certificate that identifies and authenticates the merchant's PayPal account for **Express Checkout** API calls. Used instead of API signature credentials when certificate authentication is selected. Can be set per website.

comment: Whether Express Checkout runs against the PayPal sandbox instead of the live environment.
modal: When **Yes**, Express Checkout uses the PayPal sandbox for testing; when **No**, it processes live transactions. Can be set per website.

comment: Whether PayPal Express Checkout API calls are logged for debugging.
modal: When **Yes**, requests and responses exchanged with PayPal for Express Checkout are written to the debug log. Can be set per website.

comment: Display order of PayPal Billing Agreement among payment methods at checkout.
modal: Sets the position of the **PayPal Billing Agreement** method relative to other payment methods at checkout; lower values appear first. Can be set per website and per store view.

comment: Whether the PayPal smart button on the cart page uses custom styling.
modal: When **Yes**, the PayPal button on the **Cart Page** uses the custom appearance settings; when **No**, it uses PayPal's defaults. Can be set per website and per store view.

comment: Color of the PayPal smart button on the checkout page.
modal: Chooses the color of the PayPal button shown on the **Checkout Page**, from the available button colors. Applies only when button customization is enabled for that location. Can be set per website and per store view.

comment: Color of the PayPal smart button in the mini cart.
modal: Chooses the color of the PayPal button shown in the **Mini Cart**, from the available button colors. Applies only when button customization is enabled for that location. Can be set per website and per store view.

comment: Background color of the header area on PayPal-hosted checkout pages.
modal: Sets the header background color shown on PayPal-hosted pages during checkout, part of the **Frontend Experience Settings**. Can be set per website and per store view.

comment: Color of the PayPal smart button on product detail pages.
modal: Chooses the color of the PayPal button shown on **Product Pages**, from the available button colors. Applies only when button customization is enabled for that location. Can be set per website and per store view.

comment: Whether individual cart line items are sent to PayPal with the order.
modal: When **Yes**, each cart line item is transferred to PayPal so the itemized breakdown appears on the PayPal side; when **No**, only the order total is sent. Can be set per website.

comment: Turns the Payflow Express Checkout payment method on or off.
modal: When **Yes**, the Payflow **Express Checkout** method is available to shoppers; when **No**, it is disabled. Can be set per website.

comment: Encrypted password that authenticates the store's PayPal Payflow Link account.
modal: The password used to authenticate the merchant's **Payflow Link** account with PayPal. Stored encrypted. Can be set per website.

comment: Whether Payflow Express Checkout API calls are logged for debugging.
modal: When **Yes**, requests and responses exchanged with PayPal for Payflow Express Checkout are written to the debug log. Can be set per website.

comment: Whether the Payflow Express Checkout button appears on product detail pages.
modal: When **Yes**, the Payflow Express Checkout button is shown on the product details page; when **No**, it is not. Can be set per website and per store view.

comment: Whether PayPal sends an order confirmation email for Payflow Link transactions.
modal: When **Yes**, PayPal sends an email confirmation for Payflow Link payments; when **No**, it does not. Can be set per website.

comment: Whether SSL peer verification is enforced on Payflow Link connections.
modal: When **Yes**, the SSL certificate of the Payflow Link endpoint is verified on each connection; when **No**, verification is skipped. Can be set per website.

comment: Whether Payments Pro Hosted Solution API calls are logged for debugging.
modal: When **Yes**, requests and responses exchanged with PayPal for the Hosted Pro method are written to the debug log. Can be set per website.

comment: Encrypted password that authenticates the store's PayPal Payflow Pro account.
modal: The password used to authenticate the merchant's **Payflow Pro** account with PayPal. Stored encrypted. Can be set per website.

comment: Checkout label shown for saved (vaulted) Payflow Pro cards.
modal: The method title displayed to customers for stored Payflow Pro cards (card vault) at checkout. Can be set per website.

comment: Whether a Payflow Pro AVS street-address mismatch is treated as a failed check.
modal: When **Yes**, a transaction where the Address Verification Service reports the street address does not match is treated as a failed address check. Part of the **CVV and AVS Settings**. Can be set per website.

comment: Whether customers must enter the card CVV for Payflow Pro payments.
modal: When **Yes**, the card security code (CVV) is required for Payflow Pro card payments; when **No**, it is not requested. Can be set per website.

comment: Hostname or IP of the proxy server used for Payflow Advanced connections.
modal: The proxy server address used when connecting to PayPal for Payments Advanced / Payflow. Applies only when proxy use is enabled. Can be set per website.

comment: Whether Payflow Advanced is offered to all allowed countries or only specific ones.
modal: Chooses whether the Payflow Advanced method is available for all allowed countries or only a specified list of countries. Can be set per website.
